state_contract.model: Accept 1..8 finite complex 2×2 Kraus operators per supplied channel and eps in [1e-12,1e-6]. Require ||sum_a K_a†K_a-I||_F<=eps before enabling the trace-preserving channel. For any valid single-qubit rho compute E(rho)=sum_a K_a rho K_a† and verify Hermiticity, trace one and PSD within tolerance. Derive affine Bloch coefficients from action on I and Pauli X,Y,Z, then map r_out=A r_in+t. Compose two supplied channels in explicit order E2∘E1 with the complete derived product set {N_b M_a}, allowing up to 64 derived operators. Never truncate that set; reject any further composition that would exceed the declared derived budget, and never reverse order by display layout. Exact presets declare their parameter conventions separately.
state_contract.authority: Supplied finite tensors, ordered identifiers, basis conventions and provenance own semantic state. Blender/glTF assets are display-only; Three.js owns validation, calculation, linked selection, failure states and exact reset.
actions: Select a Kraus operator or input state.
Compose two validated channels in declared order.
Reset operators, channel order, input and camera.

invariants: The completeness residual, output trace and minimum eigenvalue remain visible.
Direct density-matrix output agrees with affine Bloch output for diagnostic states within tolerance.
Composition E2∘E1 agrees with sequential evaluation on I,X,Y,Z and selected states.
An invalid completeness relation disables CPTP labels rather than renormalizing each output.
motion_guidance: Parameter sweeps show a family of maps, not elapsed physical time; channel composition stages use one immutable input.
creative_affordances: Choose any coherent laboratory, constellation or sculptural art direction while preserving exact labels, selectable identity and non-color encodings.
known_limits: Documentary authored recipe only; no model training, checkpoint execution, quantum hardware, Blender export, browser, renderer or interactive runtime was run.
glTF transports neutral display assets only; tensors, checkpoints, citations, basis order, dtype and provenance remain external data.

claims.statement: A quantum channel has an operator-sum form E(rho)=sum_a M_a rho M_a† with sum_a M_a†M_a=I for trace preservation; channels compose in order, and common single-qubit channels contract or shift the Bloch ball.
claims.scope: Finite-dimensional channels and the examples in Preskill Chapter 3; no device calibration or Markovian-time claim.

source_refs.locator: Sections 3.2.1, 3.2.6, 3.3.1 and 3.4.1-.3; equations 3.32, 3.35, 3.75, 3.94-.105 and amplitude-damping discussion
